title: Instant Mobile Savings Account Onboarding with Aadhaar XML
narrative: A neo-bank requires a paperless customer onboarding journey for millennial savings accounts. Applicants input basic details on mobile and perform UIDAI Aadhaar offline XML verification with OTP consent. PAN is verified against the NSDL database. In case of verification mismatch, an automated fallback route queues the application for manual branch review.
regulatory_context: RBI KYC Master Direction Section 16, PMLA 2002

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall verify customer Aadhaar identity via UIDAI offline XML verification.
The system shall validate customer PAN status with NSDL database prior to account creation.
The system shall encrypt customer biometric tokens and Aadhaar reference keys using AES-256 at rest.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: complete UIDAI XML identity verification within 3 seconds under 95th percentile load

sample_vague_phrases.vague: ensure high security for customer data
sample_vague_phrases.improved: enforce AES-256 field-level encryption and TLS 1.3 in transit for all PII

sample_conflicts.statement_a: The system shall complete all account openings entirely through automated straight-through processing without human review.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: The system shall require branch manager manual approval for all new account originations.

title: Video-based Customer Identification Process (V-CIP) for Non-Resident Indians
narrative: A commercial bank requires an overseas NRI account opening platform utilizing agent-assisted Video KYC (V-CIP). The platform captures live geotagged video, detects facial liveliness, cross-references passport and overseas address proof, and records audio interactions for audit.
regulatory_context: RBI Master Direction on V-CIP Procedure

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall capture high-resolution audio-visual recordings with tamper-evident timestamping.
The system shall archive V-CIP recordings for at least 5 years post account closure.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: maintain video stream latency below 300 milliseconds at 720p 30fps
store video recordings in WORM (Write Once Read Many) compliant encrypted cloud storage

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow offline unattended customer video selfie submissions without live officer participation.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Enforce concurrent live presence of designated banking official during V-CIP recording per RBI mandate.

title: Central KYC Registry (CKYC) Auto-Search and Fetch Engine
narrative: A wealth management portal integrates with CERSAI CKYC registry. When a client enters their PAN or Date of Birth, the system queries the CKYCR database using SFTP/API to retrieve existing CKYC records, downloading verified identity and address documents to eliminate repetitive KYC.
regulatory_context: PMLA (Maintenance of Records) Rules 2005

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall query CERSAI CKYCR API using encrypted digital signature certificates.
The system shall auto-populate onboarding forms from verified CKYC records when status is active.

sample_vague_phrases.vague: fetch CKYC records in a timely manner
sample_vague_phrases.improved: fetch and decode CKYC records from CERSAI within 4 seconds of request submission

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Always overwrite customer-entered contact details with stale CKYC records.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Prioritize customer updated address and trigger CKYC update notification to registry.

title: End-to-End Instant Unsecured Personal Loan Origination
narrative: A digital consumer lender provides automated personal loans up to Rs 500,000. Applicants submit salary bank statements via Account Aggregator. The underwriting engine computes debt-to-income ratio and credit score to execute instant loan sanction letters with Key Fact Statements.
regulatory_context: RBI Digital Lending Directions 2022

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall calculate debt-to-income ratio from financial data retrieved via Account Aggregator.
The system shall provide Key Fact Statement (KFS) stating all-inclusive APR prior to loan execution.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: render automated underwriting decision within 60 seconds of statement fetch
permit loan amounts ranging from Rs 25,000 to Rs 500,000 in multiples of Rs 5,000

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Disburse sanctioned loan funds directly into third-party payment wallets.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Disburse loan proceeds exclusively into borrower verified primary bank account per digital lending regulations.

title: Two-Wheeler & Auto Loan Financing Portal
narrative: An auto financing platform connects automotive dealerships with commercial lenders. Dealership executives capture customer Aadhaar, income documents, and vehicle hypothecation details to secure on-the-spot financing approvals for vehicle delivery.
regulatory_context: Motor Vehicles Act Hypothecation Provisions, RBI Guidelines on NBFC Auto Loans

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall verify vehicle chassis number with VAHAN database prior to loan disbursement.
The system shall execute e-Sign on hypothecation agreement via Aadhaar e-Sign gateway.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: provide in-principle auto-loan sanction within 5 minutes of document upload

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow delivery of vehicle before hypothecation endorsement is verified on VAHAN.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Prohibit disbursement and delivery until hypothecation endorsement confirmation is received from regional transport authority.

title: Home Loan Balance Transfer and Top-Up Portal
narrative: A housing finance company offers existing home loan borrowers balance transfers with lower interest rates and top-up equity loans. The system ingests property title deeds, valuation reports, and existing loan foreclosure letters to recalculate Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratios.
regulatory_context: National Housing Bank (NHB) Directions, RBI Guidelines on Housing Loans

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall compute Loan-to-Value ratio and enforce maximum 75% cap on loans exceeding Rs 75 lakhs.
The system shall mandate dual technical valuation reports for commercial and residential properties above Rs 1 crore.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: validate property appraisal against independent municipal rate databases within 2 business days

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow top-up loan disbursement before original title deeds are transferred from previous lender.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Enforce complete deposit of title deeds in company safe custody prior to releasing balance transfer check.

title: GST & Invoice-Based MSME Working Capital Financing
narrative: A fintech platform extends working capital credit lines to MSMEs based on Goods and Services Tax (GST) returns and e-Invoices. The system pulls GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B filings, evaluates supplier concentration, and facilitates TReDS trade receivables discounting.
regulatory_context: MSMED Act 2006, RBI Guidelines on TReDS Platform

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall authenticate with GSTN portal via GSP to fetch 12-month sales return filings.
The system shall flag any borrower where top single customer accounts for more than 40% of gross invoice turnover.

sample_vague_phrases.vague: handle high volumes of invoices easily
sample_vague_phrases.improved: process batches of up to 10,000 invoices per minute without dropping requests

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Finance invoices without buyer acceptance confirmation on the factoring exchange.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Disburse working capital only after explicit buyer digital acceptance of invoice liabilities.

title: Supply Chain Reverse Factoring Platform
narrative: An anchor-led supply chain finance solution enables tier-1 corporate anchors to provide dynamic discounting to their component suppliers. Early payments are disbursed against verified delivery receipts with automatic ERP integration.
regulatory_context: Factoring Regulation Act 2011

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall ingest ERP Goods Receipt Notes via webhook with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: compute daily discounting yield using annualized APR formula with 4 decimal place precision

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow supplier invoice discounting prior to anchor inspection sign-off.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Block supplier discounting until anchor issues clean Goods Receipt Note.

title: Syndicated Commercial Real Estate Debt Platform
narrative: A platform for structuring multi-bank syndicated loan facilities for commercial development projects. The system manages debt tranches, collateral escrow, interest accruals, and covenant monitoring across lead arrangers and participant banks.
regulatory_context: RBI Prudential Framework for Resolution of Stressed Assets

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall compute Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) quarterly and alert syndicate members if ratio drops below 1.25.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: generate multi-bank facility ledger reports within 10 seconds of quarter-end batch close

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow lead arranger to modify covenant thresholds unilaterally.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Enforce majority lender consent (>= 66% voting rights) for any material covenant amendment.

title: High-Throughput UPI Switch and Settlement Engine
narrative: A major payment aggregator deploys an in-house UPI switch routing transactions directly to NPCI. The switch manages Virtual Payment Address (VPA) resolution, bank account debit/credit, settlement reconciliation, and refunds for failed transactions.
regulatory_context: NPCI UPI Operating Regulations, RBI Guidelines on Harmonisation of Turn Around Time (TAT) for Failed Transactions

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall execute UPI transaction switching within 1500 milliseconds end-to-end latency.
The system shall auto-reversal and refund failed debit transactions within T+1 day in compliance with RBI TAT mandates.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: sustain throughput of 25,000 transactions per second at sub-200ms processing time

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow offline credit processing when NPCI acknowledgment is missing.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Never credit merchant account without synchronous cryptographic confirmation from NPCI switch.

title: UPI AutoPay Recurring Mandate Subscriptions
narrative: A recurring billing platform enables OTT subscriptions, mutual fund SIPs, and utility bills via UPI AutoPay. Users set up recurring mandates up to Rs 15,000 with one-time UPI PIN authentication, receiving pre-debit notifications 24 hours prior to automated debit.
regulatory_context: RBI Framework on Processing of e-Mandates for Recurring Transactions

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall dispatch pre-debit notification to user registered mobile and email at least 24 hours before mandate execution.
The system shall allow users to pause, modify, or revoke active mandates through the application interface with immediate effect.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: send SMS and push pre-debit notification exactly 24 to 48 hours prior to debit attempt

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Execute recurring debit even if pre-debit notification fails to deliver.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Abort automated debit execution if pre-debit notification delivery cannot be verified per RBI directive.

title: Cross-Border UPI Remittance and Inward Payment Gateway
narrative: A cross-border payments bridge enables tourists and non-residents to make UPI QR payments in international destinations. The engine handles foreign currency conversion, real-time FX markups, and statutory Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) reporting.
regulatory_context: FEMA 1999, RBI Regulations on Cross-Border Payment Linkages

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall lock foreign exchange rate for 120 seconds upon QR scan for user confirmation.
The system shall track annual remittances against LRS threshold of USD 250,000 per financial year.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: calculate foreign exchange rates with fixed 1.5% spread over mid-market interbank rate

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Permit cross-border payments without capturing purpose code to speed up checkout.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Mandate selection of valid RBI outward remittance purpose code on every cross-border transaction.

title: Virtual Card Issuance and Dynamic CVV Engine
narrative: A fintech launches single-use and subscription virtual credit cards with dynamic 3-digit CVVs refreshing every 5 minutes. The platform supports spend controls, category merchant blocking, and instant card freezing via mobile app.
regulatory_context: PCI-DSS Requirement 3, RBI Master Direction on Credit and Debit Card Issuance

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall never store raw card CVV/CVC codes on persistent disk after authorization.
The system shall regenerate dynamic CVV every 300 seconds and invalidate previous tokens.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: block all incoming card authorizations within 100ms of user tap on freeze button

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Store complete Primary Account Numbers (PAN) in server log files for debugging.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Enforce strict truncation/masking of PAN displaying only last 4 digits in all logs and interfaces.

title: Android Smart POS Terminal Acquiring Engine
narrative: A merchant acquiring service deploys smart Android POS devices with NFC contactless tap-to-pay, EMV chip reader, and soundbox voice confirmations. The engine integrates with Visa/Mastercard/RuPay gateways and enforces dual-currency settlement.
regulatory_context: EMVCo Contactless Specifications, PCI-PTS Security Requirements

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall support NFC contactless transactions without PIN entry for transactions up to Rs 5,000.

sample_vague_phrases.vague: ensure fast POS checkout at counter
sample_vague_phrases.improved: complete contactless tap-to-pay transaction authorization in under 1200ms

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Permit contactless transactions above Rs 5,000 without requiring PIN entry.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Enforce mandatory PIN entry for all contactless transactions exceeding Rs 5,000 threshold.

title: Card-on-File Tokenization (CoFT) Vault
narrative: An e-commerce payment gateway implements RBI-mandated Card-on-File Tokenization. The vault replaces stored card numbers with unique merchant-specific tokens issued by card networks, ensuring merchants do not retain original card credentials.
regulatory_context: RBI Directives on Tokenisation - Card Transactions

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall store primary card numbers exclusively inside a certified PCI-DSS Hardware Security Module (HSM).

sample_vague_phrases.improved: return tokenized card representation within 800 milliseconds from card network TSP

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow merchants to cache unmasked PAN numbers on their local database for recurring billing.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Strictly prohibit merchant storage of raw card PAN numbers; require network tokens for all card-on-file transactions.

title: Goal-Based Automated Mutual Fund Portfolio Rebalancing
narrative: A digital wealth advisory platform tracks investor goals (retirement, child education). When market shifts trigger asset allocation drift of more than 5% from target risk profile, the robo-engine computes tax-efficient rebalancing buy/sell orders.
regulatory_context: SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations 2013

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall trigger rebalancing alert when asset class allocation drifts more than 5 percentage points from target risk baseline.
The system shall enforce mandatory annual risk profile questionnaire recertification before executing new advisory orders.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: generate portfolios with Sharpe ratio optimized asset allocations aligned with investor verified risk tolerance score

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Execute automated portfolio rebalancing trades without obtaining explicit investor confirmation.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Require explicit investor approval for all rebalancing order batches before routing to exchange.

title: Direct Mutual Fund Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) Engine
narrative: An investment app enables zero-commission direct mutual fund SIPs routing orders via BSE StAR MF and NSE NMF II platforms. The system executes daily and monthly SIPs, validates Net Asset Value (NAV) cut-off timings, and reconciles unit allotments.
regulatory_context: SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations on NAV Allotment Cut-offs

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall route purchase orders prior to 14:30 IST cut-off to guarantee same-day NAV allotment.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: reconcile units allotted with AMC registrar files within 24 hours with zero monetary discrepancy

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allot same-day NAV based on order placement time regardless of when funds realize at exchange.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Allot NAV strictly based on time of realization of funds in AMC bank account per SEBI circular.

title: Fixed Deposit and Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) Aggregator
narrative: A wealth platform aggregates corporate and small-finance bank Fixed Deposits with Reserve Bank of India Sovereign Gold Bond issuances. The platform allows instant paperless booking with DIGILOCKER-backed KYC and automated maturity interest payout instructions.
regulatory_context: RBI Directions on Deposit Acceptance, Income Tax Section 194A (TDS)

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall compute TDS deduction at 10% on interest income exceeding Rs 40,000 per financial year for non-senior citizens.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: support deposit tenures ranging from 7 days to 10 years in 1-day increments

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow non-residents to purchase Sovereign Gold Bonds under domestic investor quota.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Enforce residency filter restricting Sovereign Gold Bond subscription exclusively to Indian resident individuals and trusts.

title: Real-Time Payment Fraud Anomaly Detection Engine
narrative: A core payment gateway deploys a real-time behavioral fraud detection engine. The system scores every credit card and UPI transaction across 50 risk dimensions (velocity, IP geodistance, device fingerprint, behavioral biometrics, and mule account lists) in sub-50 milliseconds.
regulatory_context: RBI Master Directions on Cyber Security Framework in Banks

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall score transaction risk in under 45 milliseconds without causing gateway timeouts.
The system shall challenge transactions with risk score between 60 and 85 with step-up out-of-band biometric authentication.

sample_vague_phrases.vague: detect fraudulent transactions with high accuracy
sample_vague_phrases.improved: maintain fraud detection true-positive rate above 94% with false-positive rate under 0.8%

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Automatically decline all transactions originating from roaming IP addresses without notification.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Route suspicious roaming transactions to step-up authentication instead of silent cancellation.

title: Suspicious Transaction Reporting (STR) & AML Monitoring System
narrative: A bank-wide AML surveillance suite ingests transactions across RTGS, NEFT, cash deposits, and wire transfers. It flags structuring (smurfing), sudden turnover spikes, and high-risk sanctions matches to compile Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) for Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU-IND).
regulatory_context: PMLA 2002 Section 12, FIU-IND Reporting Guidelines

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall generate XML formatted Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) conforming to FIU-IND schema v2.0.
The system shall file STR with FIU-IND within seven business days of Principal Officer determination of suspicion.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: flag cash deposit clusters totaling > Rs 10 lakhs in 30 days split into increments under Rs 50,000

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Notify account holders whenever an STR alert is generated on their profile.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Strictly enforce anti-tipping-off provisions; under no circumstances alert customer about STR investigation per PMLA §12.

title: PEP (Politically Exposed Persons) and Global Sanctions Screening Engine
narrative: An onboarding sanctions screening engine matches individuals and beneficial owners against OFAC, UN Security Council, and domestic MHA UAPA terrorist lists. The engine applies fuzzy phonetic matching (Double Metaphone, Levenshtein distance) to identify transliteration variants.
regulatory_context: Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA), FATF Recommendation 6 & 7

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall execute fuzzy name matching against daily-updated UN and OFAC sanctions lists with match threshold set to 85%.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: synchronize and re-index official UN and OFAC sanctions XML feeds within 60 minutes of publication

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow account opening to proceed when an exact match against UAPA terrorist list is detected.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Immediately freeze assets and block onboarding on confirmed UAPA match, alerting nodal officer within 24 hours.

title: Corporate FX Forward Booking and Hedging Portal
narrative: A treasury portal enables corporate export-import clients to book forward contracts and currency options to hedge foreign currency exposures. The platform streams live interbank spot rates, calculates forward premia based on interest rate parity, and verifies underlying trade contracts.
regulatory_context: RBI Directions on Hedging of Foreign Exchange Risk

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall compute forward premia using interest rate parity curve for tenors up to 365 days.
The system shall mandate documentary proof of underlying contracted trade exposure prior to booking non-deliverable forwards.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: stream real-time interbank FX quotes with price updates every 250 milliseconds during market hours

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow corporate entities to book speculative FX contracts without documented underlying commercial exposure.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Enforce strict prohibition against speculative trades, verifying underlying export-import contracts for every forward booking.

title: Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) & Net Stable Funding (NSFR) Engine
narrative: An asset-liability management (ALM) engine tracks high-quality liquid assets (HQLA) and projected cash outflows across 30-day stressed liquidity horizons. It generates regulatory Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio reports and alerts treasury managers of buffer deficits.
regulatory_context: RBI Master Circular on Basel III - Liquidity Coverage Ratio

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall compute daily Liquidity Coverage Ratio and enforce mandatory minimum buffer of 100%.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: compute weighted cash inflow and outflow projections across all operational currencies daily by 18:00 IST

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Include uncommitted non-operational corporate credit lines as Level 1 High Quality Liquid Assets.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Exclude non-operational corporate credit lines from HQLA calculation per Basel III asset classification rules.

title: Interbank Money Market and Call/Notice Borrowing Platform
narrative: A primary dealer and scheduled bank money-market trading terminal handles overnight call money, notice money, and repo transactions on the Clearing Corporation of India (CCIL) platform. It calculates accrued interest, tracks collateral pledges, and settles via RBI RTGS.
regulatory_context: RBI Directions on Money Market Instruments

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall execute straight-through processing to CCIL NDS-CALL platform with digital deal ticket confirmation.

sample_vague_phrases.vague: settle money market deals on time
sample_vague_phrases.improved: transmit RTGS settlement instructions for matched deals within 15 minutes of trade execution

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow overnight borrowing deals to exceed the prudential internal limit set by ALCO without board approval.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Enforce strict hard-stop validation rejecting deal entry if borrowing volume breaches ALCO prudential ceiling.

title: Digital Documentary Letter of Credit (LC) Issuance & Presentation
narrative: A trade finance portal facilitates issuance, amendment, and presentation of documentary Letters of Credit under ICC UCP 600 rules. The platform ingests electronic Bills of Lading, Commercial Invoices, and Inspection Certificates, utilizing OCR and NLP to detect documentary discrepancies.
regulatory_context: ICC UCP 600, FEMA 1999 Regulations on Trade Credit

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall validate presented commercial invoice value does not exceed LC drawing limit.
The system shall issue SWIFT MT700 / MX messaging formatted under ISO 20022 standards.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: highlight discrepancies between shipping documents and LC terms within 2 hours of document upload

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Authorize LC payment despite unaccepted discrepant bill of lading presentation.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Refuse honor and issue notice of discrepancy within 5 banking days if shipping documents do not strictly comply with UCP 600.

title: Bank Guarantee (BG) Issuance & National e-Governance (NeSL) e-BG Platform
narrative: A corporate banking platform provides instant electronic Bank Guarantees (e-BG) in partnership with National E-Governance Services Ltd (NeSL). The system automates digital stamping, Aadhaar e-Sign execution, and electronic transmission to public sector beneficiaries.
regulatory_context: Indian Stamp Act, NeSL Electronic Bank Guarantee Operating Guidelines

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall integrate with NeSL e-BG portal via REST API to procure digital stamp duty and register guarantee.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: complete e-BG registration and beneficiary notification within 30 minutes of collateral earmarking

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow e-BG issuance with unverified or uncollected state stamp duty amounts.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Enforce mandatory real-time electronic stamp duty receipt verification before releasing e-BG certificate.

title: Export Data Processing and Monitoring System (EDPMS) Reconciliation
narrative: An automated trade compliance utility reconciles outward bank remittances against shipping bills recorded in the Reserve Bank of India EDPMS database. It tracks unclosed shipping bills, flags regulatory overdue export proceeds, and compiles Caution-listing alerts.
regulatory_context: RBI Master Direction on Export of Goods and Services

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall match export proceeds received with open shipping bills within 9 months of export shipment.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: reconcile inward foreign remittance certificates with EDPMS shipping bill files daily at 23:00 IST

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow manual deletion of unresolved overdue shipping bills from regulatory audit logs.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Maintain immutable audit trail of all open shipping bills, reporting entries overdue beyond 9 months directly in RBI EDPMS upload.

title: Multi-Currency Corporate Current Account Ledger
narrative: A core banking subsystem maintains real-time double-entry ledgers for corporate current accounts across INR, USD, EUR, and GBP. It computes daily sweep balances, overdraft limits, interest accruals, and enforces segregation of customer client funds.
regulatory_context: RBI Guidelines on Opening of Current Accounts by Banks

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall post all financial transactions using strict balanced double-entry accounting (Debits == Credits).
The system shall prevent overdraft drawings exceeding sanctioned credit limit without authorized supervisor override.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: maintain zero cent/paisa rounding discrepancy across all multi-currency balance rollups

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow accounts with unauthorized negative balances to continue processing outgoing wire payments.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Automatically freeze outgoing payments when ledger balance falls below zero in the absence of an active overdraft agreement.

title: Inoperative Account & Unclaimed Deposit (DEAF) Transfer Engine
narrative: A statutory compliance engine tracks accounts with zero customer-induced transactions over 24 months, automatically transitioning them to inoperative status. Accounts remaining unclaimed for 10 years are transferred to the RBI Depositor Education and Awareness Fund (DEAF).
regulatory_context: The Depositor Education and Awareness Fund Scheme 2014, RBI Directions on Inoperative Accounts

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall transfer unclaimed deposit balances older than 10 years to RBI DEAF account on the last working day of each month.

sample_vague_phrases.vague: flag inactive accounts in good time
sample_vague_phrases.improved: classify accounts as inoperative exactly when 730 consecutive days elapse without customer-induced transactions

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow debit transactions on inoperative accounts without fresh customer KYC verification.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Block all debit transactions on inoperative accounts until fresh KYC documents are verified by branch manager.

title: Positive Pay System (PPS) for High-Value Cheque Clearance
narrative: A cheque clearance subsystem enforces the Positive Pay System for CTS cheque clearing. Issuers re-confirm key cheque details (cheque number, date, payee name, amount) for cheques above Rs 50,000, cross-matching details during clearing to prevent altered cheque fraud.
regulatory_context: RBI Positive Pay System for Cheque Truncation System (CTS)

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall cross-reference CTS clearing presentation against customer-submitted Positive Pay records for all cheques >= Rs 50,000.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: complete CTS image and Positive Pay record verification within 2 hours of inward clearing file ingestion

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Clear high-value cheques above Rs 500,000 even when Positive Pay confirmation is missing.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Return unpaid any cheque above Rs 500,000 where issuer has not submitted Positive Pay confirmation per bank policy.

title: DigiLocker Integration Gateway for Statutory Document Fetch
narrative: A financial verification gateway connects to National DigiLocker. Borrowers and investors provide Aadhaar-based consent to retrieve authentic issuer-signed PDF documents including driving licenses, vehicle RC, LPG receipts, and educational degrees directly from government issuing authorities.
regulatory_context: Information Technology (Preservation and Retention of Information by Intermediaries) Rules, DPDP Act 2023

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall verify SHA-256 PKI digital signatures on issuer documents retrieved from DigiLocker API.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: retrieve and validate digitally signed documents from DigiLocker in under 3.5 seconds

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Accept unverified manually uploaded PDFs as equivalent to cryptographically signed DigiLocker documents.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Require verified digital signature from authentic issuing authority before marking verification as complete.

title: Account Aggregator Financial Information User (FIU) Gateway
narrative: A lending portal implements the RBI Account Aggregator (AA) framework as a Financial Information User. The engine requests electronic, granular, revocable consent to ingest structured bank statement data from Financial Information Providers (FIPs).
regulatory_context: RBI Master Direction on Non-Banking Financial Company - Account Aggregator Directions 2016

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall request electronic customer consent specifying exact purpose, data types, and expiry duration.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: display exact date range, account numbers, and access duration on consent screen before user PIN confirmation

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Retain decrypted bank transaction data indefinitely after credit decision is made.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Purge all detailed financial statements from application memory after credit decisioning per consent terms.

title: e-Sign 3.0 Biometric and OTP Digital Agreement Execution
narrative: A legal contract workflow service integrates with licensed Certifying Authorities (C-DAC, NSDL) to enable Aadhaar e-Sign 3.0 on loan agreements, guarantees, and mandates, producing legally admissible PDF contracts under Section 5 of the Information Technology Act 2000.
regulatory_context: Information Technology Act 2000 Section 5, Electronic Signature Service Provider (ESP) Guidelines

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall embed X.509 PKI digital signature certificate directly into agreement PDF.

sample_vague_phrases.improved: complete e-Sign roundtrip with eMudhra/CDAC within 4 seconds of OTP submission

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow agreement signing when customer Aadhaar OTP verification fails.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Strictly block document execution and refuse stamp application if Aadhaar OTP fails or expires.

title: Joint Liability Group (JLG) Microfinance Origination & Center Meeting App
narrative: A microfinance institution deploys an offline-first Android tablet app for rural loan officers conducting weekly center meetings. Officers verify 5-member Joint Liability Groups (JLG), capture group biometric consent, log loan repayments, and synchronize collections with core banking upon network restoration.
regulatory_context: RBI Regulatory Framework for Microfinance Loans 2022

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall operate in offline mode, storing encrypted repayment transactions locally on tablet.
The system shall verify that borrower annual household income does not exceed Rs 300,000 per RBI microfinance criteria.

sample_vague_phrases.vague: sync data when internet becomes available
sample_vague_phrases.improved: synchronize local repayment records with core server within 60 seconds of network connectivity detection

sample_conflicts.statement_a: Allow total monthly debt repayments to exceed 50% of verified monthly household income.
sample_conflicts.statement_b: Enforce strict limit capping total household debt obligations to maximum 50% of monthly household income per RBI guidelines.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Crop Loan Digital Disbursement Engine
narrative: A regional rural bank digitizes Kisan Credit Card disbursements for small and marginal farmers. The platform links state land revenue land parcel records (Bhoomi/AnyRoR) to compute scale of finance based on crop type, disbursing fertilizer sub-limits and cash credit directly to farmer accounts.
regulatory_context: RBI Guidelines on Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme, Priority Sector Lending (PSL) Norms

sample_requirements.statement: The system shall calculate loan eligibility using district Scale of Finance multiplied by verified land acreage.
